review_notes: All 100 identities, selected field shapes, source links and claim mappings checked; 15 item pages rendered separately as a cross-section. Not independent observation of every item.
Seller text is one seller/shop pair, not two sellers. Technical labels are retained, not expanded into guessed coordinates.
Only three exact existing quest-stage IDs are linked. Priscus the Ancient is an actor in canon, so a same-named quest link does not become that actor relation.
Fluttering Radiance Plate Boots Required to Learn links a miscellaneous source entry with the same title; no self-referential item prerequisite is invented.
Five recipes retain the Cook KukuPot source label; no ordinary cooking or default blacksmith conversion is inferred.
Dark Executioner epilogue quest context is ending-level; generic acquisition-source metadata does not disclose its stage to lower spoiler levels.
Three map-only items receive one short additional guide route each. Map coordinates, respawn claims and detailed unlock gates are not certified.
All DB sources share one unresolved-upstream group; guides retain their own known upstream attribution. No claim receives independent corroboration or patch-review credit.
remaining_limits: No complete recipe/material/cost tables or general current-stock guarantee.
A listed crafting route may be internal or unavailable; live implementation and unlock state are unverified.
Missing fields and unvisited entries are gaps, not assertions of unobtainability.
Two published releases remain unchanged. No public release, hosting or next wave authorized.
